news.headline: Roth Capital Initiates Forgent Power Solutions at Buy
news.summary: Roth Capital (Roth/MKM) started coverage of Forgent at Buy, citing its differentiated exposure to AI-infrastructure build-outs through data-center power-distribution equipment. The initiation lands at the 52-week low, a week before the November 12 fiscal Q1 report.

news.headline: Forgent Power Solutions (NYSE:FPS) Hits New 52-Week Low
news.summary: After gapping lower on November 4, FPS slid to a new 52-week low on November 5, fully erasing its late-October rebound a week before the fiscal Q1 report. Options are pricing roughly an 11% move on the November 12 earnings release.

news.headline: Jim Cramer Calls Forgent Power a 'Really Really Good' Company
news.summary: On Mad Money, Jim Cramer reaffirmed his long-running bullish view, calling Forgent a 'really really good' company ahead of its November 12 report. He has backed the data-center power equipment maker repeatedly since its February IPO, though he has also flagged its premium valuation.

news.headline: Forgent Power Solutions to Invest $3 Million in Downtown Columbus Office, Adding 85 Jobs
news.summary: Forgent plans a $3 million office in downtown Columbus, Ohio, adding 85 jobs. The expansion supports headcount growth as the company scales to work through its roughly $3 billion order backlog for data-center and utility electrical equipment.

news.headline: Clear Street Initiates Forgent Power Solutions at Buy With $58 Target
news.summary: Clear Street started coverage at Buy with a $58 price target, and the shares rebounded about 6-7% over the following sessions after the CFO-exit sell-off. It joins Bernstein (Outperform) among the bullish houses ahead of the first quarterly report under the new CFO.

news.headline: Forgent Announces CFO Transition: Ryan Fiedler Steps Down, Amy Ard Appointed CFO
news.summary: CFO Ryan Fiedler is stepping down for personal reasons about a year after joining, moving into an external consulting role; EVP of Finance Amy Ard, who has more than 25 years of finance experience, succeeds him. An 8-K/A stressed the departure was not due to any disagreement, but the shares fell about 11% that day on the surprise exit. In the same 8-K the company said fiscal Q1 revenue and adjusted EBITDA will exceed the high end of its guidance ranges and set the report for November 12.

catalysts.label: Fiscal Q1 2027 results (before open) and 11:00 a.m. ET call
catalysts.detail: Forgent reports the quarter ended September 30 before the market opens on November 12. Its October 22 8-K already said revenue and adjusted EBITDA will beat the high end of guidance (prior guide: roughly $445-465M revenue and $90-100M adjusted EBITDA, per Zacks), so the focus moves to the size of the beat, order intake, the ~$3B backlog and full-year FY2027 guidance in Amy Ard's first report as CFO. Consensus revenue for the quarter sits around $461M.

catalysts.label: Manufacturing capacity expansion and new Columbus office
catalysts.detail: Forgent is adding capacity and staff (including a $3 million, 85-job Columbus office) to work through a roughly $3 billion backlog of switchgear and power-distribution equipment for data centers and utilities. Delivery pace is the main lever for revenue upside versus guidance.

pulse: As of November 6, 2026, Forgent (NYSE: FPS), the February-2026 IPO supplying power-distribution equipment to AI data centers and utilities, trades at a new 52-week low after erasing the late-October rebound that followed the roughly 23% slide on the October 22 CFO exit (Ryan Fiedler replaced internally by Amy Ard; 'no disagreement' per 8-K/A). Sell-side support keeps building, with Roth initiating at Buy on November 6 after Clear Street's Buy ($58 target) and Bernstein's Outperform, and the company has already pre-announced that fiscal Q1 revenue and adjusted EBITDA beat the top of guidance. Options imply about an 11% move on the November 12 report, where the size of the beat, order growth on the ~$3B backlog and FY2027 guidance are the decisive tests.
